manifest_entries.name: First Strict Pull-Up
manifest_entries.adapts: Intake picks your tier; drills adapt weekly to your weakest capability (grip, scap, row, negative).
manifest_entries.short_description: Multi-tier skill program on the shared pull drill library. Grip → scap → negative → band → unassisted, then volume. Personalised sessions target your weakest sub-capability first.
manifest_entries.who_this_is_for: You want a strict pull-up. Some athletes can't dead-hang 15 seconds yet; some do 1-2 reps and want to hit 5. The app meets you where you are and builds each sub-capability separately. Not for kipping pull-ups — that's a different skill.
manifest_entries.what_youll_achieve: Beginners: 25-45 second dead hang, clean scap pulls, first ring rows. Assisted-only lifters: first strict rep from a 10-second negative. First-repper: 3-5 unbroken. Volume tier: 8-10 unbroken with wide-grip variety unlocked.
manifest_entries.retest: Weekly max-rep retest (Tier C/D) or weekly hang-time retest (Tier A/B); every 4 weeks: full assessment (dead hang, scap pull, ring row, strict pull-up, negative control).

manifest_entries.name: Muscle-Up Acquisition (strict ring)
manifest_entries.adapts: Intake gates on prerequisites (3+ strict pull-ups, 3+ ring dips), then picks your tier by muscle-up experience.
prerequisites: 3+ strict pull-ups (no kip, no swing, dead hang to chin over bar).
3+ strict ring dips (support → 90° elbow → lockout, no leg swing).
If either is below the threshold, intake routes you to First Strict Pull-Up or an equivalent dip build first.
manifest_entries.short_description: Multi-tier strict ring muscle-up program. Reuses pull-up + handstand drill libraries. False-grip base, transition mechanics, ring dip strength. Not for kipping muscle-ups — different skill, different program.
manifest_entries.who_this_is_for: You have your strict pull-ups and ring dips and now want the strict ring muscle-up. The transition is the bottleneck — not the pull, not the dip. This program isolates it: seated-band, low-ring negatives, jump-assist, first strict attempt.
manifest_entries.what_youll_achieve: Prep tier: 3-5 strict ring dips, 15s false-grip hang. Transition tier: seated-band mastered, first low-ring muscle-up, first strict attempt week 8-10. First Rep tier: 2-3 strict ring muscle-ups unbroken with weighted-preview singles.
manifest_entries.retest: Weekly max-rep retest (Tier C) or false-grip hang + ring dip retest (Tier A/B); every 4 weeks: full assessment battery.

manifest_entries.name: Engine Builder — Block 2: Volume
manifest_entries.adapts: Intake gates on Block 1 completion (or equivalent base) and picks tier by current cardio hours + Block 1 delta.
prerequisites: Engine Builder Block 1 completed within the last 4 weeks OR an equivalent 8-week aerobic base (5+ hrs/week cardio, can hold Z1 for 75+ min).
Chest-strap HR monitor strongly recommended — half the block's target zones sit in the range where wrist-optical HR drops out.
manifest_entries.short_description: Block 2 of the 3-block engine transformation. 8-12 weeks. Two hard sessions per week — a threshold cruise + a VO2max session that alternates 4×4 and short-interval formats — on top of a rising Z1 volume floor. Threshold pace shift is the headline metric.
manifest_entries.who_this_is_for: You finished Block 1 (or have an equivalent base) and want to keep going. Block 2 is where the majority of VO2max and threshold gains land — but only after the base is in. This is a sharp-end block: two hard sessions per week, more time, more intensity.
manifest_entries.what_youll_achieve: Threshold pace / power shift 2-5% by tier. Additional VO2max +4-9% on top of Block 1. Submax HR at fixed pace additional -3 to -8 bpm. Retest at week 4 (mid-block check) and week 8-10 (end-of-block).
manifest_entries.retest: 20-min TT + submax HR at fixed pace at week 4 and week 8-10. Modality-specific TT (2K row / 5K run) at end-of-block if applicable.
manifest_entries.physical_test_prerequisite: Fresh 20-min TT within the last 4 weeks OR schedule one in week 1 Wednesday.
